registration.statement: For one retained ligand carrier attached to one retained central occurrence, denticity is the positive cardinality of its complete distinct donor-site incidences. One site is open; the next separate site is the first successor that closes a carrier-centre path and forces chelation; every later site preserves closure and increments denticity once.
registration.title: Exact ligand denticity and chelation from connected donor-site topology
